request: when do the clock hands next overlap after 12 o'clock?

beats.intent: A clock at 12:00 with both hands pointing up together
beats.narration: At twelve o'clock the hands lie on top of each other.
beats.code:
stage.title("When do the hands meet?")
face = Circle(radius=2.2, color=WHITE).move_to([-2.5, -0.3, 0])
c = face.get_center()
ticks = VGroup(*[Line(c + 2.0 * np.array([np.sin(k * PI / 6), np.cos(k * PI / 6), 0]), c + 2.2 * np.array([np.sin(k * PI / 6), np.cos(k * PI / 6), 0]), color=GREY_B) for k in range(12)])
t = ValueTracker(0)
hand = lambda length, per_min, col, w: always_redraw(lambda: Line(c, c + length * np.array([np.sin(per_min * t.get_value() * DEGREES), np.cos(per_min * t.get_value() * DEGREES), 0]), color=col, stroke_width=w))
minute = hand(1.9, 6, BLUE, 5)
hour = hand(1.2, 0.5, ORANGE, 9)
stage.play(Create(face), Create(ticks))
stage.add(hour, minute)

beats.intent: The minute hand sweeping round once while the hour hand creeps to 1
beats.narration: In one hour the minute hand goes all the way round, but the hour hand has moved on to one.
beats.code:
stage.play(t.animate.set_value(60), run_time=3, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("1:00: the hour hand has moved on")

beats.intent: The minute hand catching the hour hand a little after 1:05
beats.narration: The minute hand has to catch up a little more: they meet at about five past one, twenty seven seconds after.
beats.code:
stage.play(t.animate.set_value(65.45), run_time=1.5, rate_func=linear)
stage.caption("they meet at about 1:05:27")

beats.intent: The clock beside 6t = 360 + 0.5t, so t = 65 5/11 minutes
beats.narration: The minute hand turns six degrees a minute, the hour hand half a degree. It gains five and a half a minute, so it needs three sixty over five and a half: sixty five and five elevenths minutes.

request: what's the mode, and how is it different from the average?

beats.intent: Bars of shoe sizes sold in a shop: sizes 5 to 10
beats.narration: A shoe shop counts the sizes it sold in a week.
beats.code:
stage.title("The mode")
b = draw_bars(stage, [3, 8, 14, 9, 5, 2], labels=["5", "6", "7", "8", "9", "10"], color=BLUE)
stage.caption("pairs sold by size")

beats.narration: The mode is the most common value: size seven, with fourteen pairs.
beats.code:
bars = b[0] if len(b) == 2 else b
highlight(stage, bars[2], color=YELLOW)
stage.caption("mode = size 7")

beats.intent: The mean size 7.3 marked beside, with its calculation
beats.narration: The mean shoe size works out at about seven point three, a size nobody actually wears.

beats.intent: The bars with the caption: the shop orders by the mode
beats.narration: For ordering stock, the mode is the useful number: it says which size to buy most of.

request: how fast will I be going at the bottom of a 5 m skate ramp?

beats.intent: A curved ramp 5 m high with a skater dot at the top
beats.narration: A skater starts at the top of a ramp five metres high.
beats.code:
stage.title("Height into speed")
ramp = VMobject(color=GREY_B, stroke_width=6).set_points_smoothly([[-5, 2.0, 0], [-4, 0.0, 0], [-2.5, -1.6, 0], [0, -2.2, 0], [4, -2.2, 0]])
skater = Dot([-5, 2.25, 0], color=YELLOW, radius=0.18)
stage.play(Create(ramp), FadeIn(skater))
stage.add(ramp, skater)
h = DoubleArrow([-5.6, 2.0, 0], [-5.6, -2.2, 0], buff=0, color=GREEN)
stage.play(GrowArrow(h))
stage.add(h)
stage.label(h, "5 m", direction=LEFT, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: The skater rolling down the curve, a speed readout climbing
beats.narration: Rolling down, height turns into speed.
beats.code:
path = ramp.copy().shift(0.25 * UP)
stage.play(MoveAlongPath(skater, path), run_time=2, rate_func=rate_functions.ease_in_quad)
stage.caption("height becomes speed")

beats.intent: Bars of energy: all height energy at the top, all motion energy at the bottom
beats.narration: Ignoring friction, all the energy from height becomes energy of motion.
beats.code:
stage.clear()
b = draw_bars(stage, [1, 0, 0, 1], labels=["height (top)", "motion (top)", "height (bottom)", "motion (bottom)"], color=ORANGE)
stage.caption("energy swaps from height to motion")

beats.intent: The bars beside v = √(2gh) = √(2 × 9.8 × 5) ≈ 9.9 m/s ≈ 36 km/h
beats.narration: So the speed at the bottom is the square root of two g h: about ten metres a second, thirty six kilometres an hour.

request: how can two people share a cake fairly without arguing?

beats.intent: A rectangular cake and two people, A with a knife
beats.narration: Two people want to share a cake fairly. A gets the knife.
beats.code:
stage.title("I cut, you choose")
cake = Rectangle(width=4, height=2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to([0, -0.3, 0])
a = Dot([-3.5, -0.3, 0], color=BLUE, radius=0.25)
bb = Dot([3.5, -0.3, 0], color=GREEN, radius=0.25)
stage.play(FadeIn(cake), FadeIn(a), FadeIn(bb))
stage.add(cake, a, bb)
stage.label(a, "A cuts", direction=DOWN, color=BLUE)
stage.label(bb, "B chooses", direction=DOWN, color=GREEN)

beats.intent: A cut dividing the cake into two pieces A thinks are equal
beats.narration: A cuts it into two pieces that A thinks are equal, because A gets whichever piece is left.

beats.intent: B picking the piece B prefers, the left piece sliding to B
beats.narration: B picks whichever piece B prefers.
beats.code:
left = Rectangle(width=2.1, height=2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to([-0.95, -0.3, 0])
right = Rectangle(width=1.9, height=2, color=ORANGE, fill_opacity=0.5).move_to([1.05, -0.3, 0])
stage.remove(cake)
stage.add(left, right)
stage.play(left.animate.next_to(bb, LEFT, buff=0.3), right.animate.next_to(a, RIGHT, buff=0.3))

beats.intent: Both pieces labelled 'at least half' from each person's view
beats.narration: A made sure both halves were fine, and B got first choice: each thinks they got at least half. No arguing needed.
beats.code:
stage.label(left, "≥ half for B", direction=UP, color=GREEN)
stage.label(right, "≥ half for A", direction=UP, color=BLUE)
stage.caption("each gets at least half, by their own judgement")
